description: This PHP source file defines classes for handling MIME attachments in SOAP web services using the NuSOAP library. Specifically, it implements mime-capable client and server classes that support attaching files and parsing multipart MIME responses and requests, leveraging the PEAR Mail_MIME library.

classes.name: nusoapclientmime
classes.description: A SOAP client class supporting MIME attachments, allowing adding, clearing, retrieving attachments, and parsing MIME responses.

classes.name: nusoapservermime
classes.description: A SOAP server class supporting MIME attachments, enabling adding attachments to responses and parsing MIME-encoded requests.

methods.name: addAttachment
methods.description: Adds a MIME attachment to the current request or response, generating a Content-ID if not provided.

methods.name: clearAttachments
methods.description: Clears all current attachments from the request or response.

methods.name: getAttachments
methods.description: Retrieves the list of attachments in the current request or response.

methods.name: getHTTPBody
methods.description: Generates the HTTP body for the SOAP message, including MIME attachments if present.

methods.name: getHTTPContentType
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate Content-Type header for the current request or response.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Processes the SOAP response, decoding MIME parts and extracting attachments.

methods.name: parseRequest
methods.description: Processes the SOAP request, decoding MIME parts and extracting attachments.
